title: STILL-PRESENT: types.odin Event comment still claims pre-4.2 streams stay byte-identical after the drop-payload fold (W3-carry incomplete)
detail: The r3 W3-carry amendment added the fold admission but left the contradictory tail verbatim: types.odin claims pre-4.2 byte-identity while serialize.odin states the opposite. Golden-discipline readers get the false claim in the same block.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the tail to serialize.odin's wording: tag-conditional payloads keep pre-4.2 streams byte-identical except the documented Packet_Dropped +4B fold.

title: Pre-W-qos RELIEVED comment left stacked above the new one — describes the old bound-only lane check, not the margin threshold the code now applies
detail: The W-qos root fix moved the lane threshold from the bound to bound - margin, but the pre-fix RELIEVED comment remains directly above the new one. It misstates the current condition (a lane at bound-1 now blocks resolution).
recommended_fix: Delete or amend the first RELIEVED comment: a lane at or above (bound - margin) blocks resolution.

title: serialize.odin event-loop comment still describes the Packet_Dropped payload as class+reason and append-only — stale after the 4.2 +4B fold
detail: w_event_payload now writes class + reason + the 4.2 shed-bundle u32 target for tag 4. The loop comment above it still names the pre-fold payload and calls it append-only, contradicting w_event_payload's own admission below.
recommended_fix: Update the comment: Packet_Dropped payload is class + reason + shed-bundle target (the documented fold); tags 8/9 are the append-only additions.
